TEXT: Oh, long time no see, my little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
It's not the time for that! J-Just what have you 
done!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Sorry sorry, my bike slipped.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Like that would happen! Don't use such a ridiculous 
excuse!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Hahahahahaha!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Well, aren't you energetic! That's a relief.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Looks like you're yelling as always. How 
short-tempered of you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I'm only short-tempered when it comes to you!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
After all, you're al-ways doing stuff that makes 
people mad!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Apologize to Kyousuke-san!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Hmph.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: ...Kyousuke-san... you said?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Y-Yes.

At this moment, Saori's sister, Kaori-san, looked at 
me again.
What the... It's like she's glaring at a cockroach.
Just like the old Kirino used to do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Who the heck are you?

That's not something you say to someone you sent 
flying.

While experiencing the intense air of intimidation 
from her, I mustered up some courage and said 
the following.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I am Saori's boyfriend.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Boyfriend? Hmmm.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
What's with that "Hmm..."? Is that all you have to 
say?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
It's a good thing I didn't come here via helicopter 
today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You mean if you traveled by helicopter, I would've 
been slammed by that instead!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That'll kill me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I thought you were a molester.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Are your eyes rotten or something?!

No matter how you look at it, we were a 
lovey-dovey couple.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Hey Saori, he sure is a rude one.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You're the rude one!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: G-Geez... Enough already, just leave...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You're in the way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
That's such a cruel thing to say to your sister you 
haven't seen in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Couldn't you at least give a "Welcome home?"

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ..."Welcome home"... Are you satisfied now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Put more "I love you Onee-chan①" sincerity into it 
and try again.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: No such feelings of that sort exist within me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
That's quite a long rebellious stage of yours. I can't 
believe you haven't gotten over it yet.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: No, I just specifically hate you in particular.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Hmph, I see. This is the so-called tsundere little 
sister, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That's not it!
You know...

It's very apparent the kind of relationship the 
Makishima sisters have, with this conversation alone.

However, what followed from Saori changed the 
mood in an instant.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: P-

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Please get over yourself!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Just what are you up to?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Disappearing as you please, returning all of a 
sudden...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Always teasing me, even messing up everyone's 
relationships...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: What is it you're trying to do!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I've always been doing whatever I please, that's all.

That was something Saori told me before at some 
point... the same exact phrase.

It's the same, but coming from a different person, it 
leaves a different impression altogether.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Of course, this time's the same.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I know all about that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Haven't you always been like that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Why don't you... stop beating around the bush?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: This time... what exactly do you want to do?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: What did you return to Japan for?

Saori bravely pushed out her chest and stared 
straight at her sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I wasn't trying to beat around the bush.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Well, I'll just be blunt then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I came to intrude on you guys.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
"That little sister of yours has gotten a boyfriend..." 
I've been hearing rumors like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: So here I am, ready to pick a fight.

I caught on to something unusual hidden within 
those spiteful words.
...This woman...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...How interesting.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I don't know how you intend to intrude in our 
affairs...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: But I don't plan on losing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
The crybaby I once knew has learned to say what 
she means.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I have confidence, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Whatever you have planned, you won't be able to 
destroy our bond.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well said.
I pat Saori on the back.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
How can we lose to someone who wants to intrude 
upon their little sister's happiness?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyosuke-san... Yes!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Good grief, it's like I'm playing the part of a villain 
now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Well, do as you please. I know I will.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I will too.
Facing the fearless smile of Kaori's.
Saori bit her lips.

There are sparks flying between the glares of these 
sisters.

Before long, Kaori got on her bike again, and 
started the engine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I'm gonna go home for today. See ya.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Let us make a move as well, Kyousuke-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
We've been attracting the attention of everyone 
around us, thanks to a certain idiot coming out 
from nowhere.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah.
She really hates her sister.
I can't say I don't understand her, but...

As a big brother with a hateful little sister, it 
definitely struck a chord within me.

As if she's trying to leave me behind, Saori walked 
off in a hurry.
And at that moment, someone called out to her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Oh, that's right, I forgot to tell you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: ...I'm home, Saori.
